what: Every already-open column's shift when a new column opens, core columns as they are on 2026-09-17.
how: Headless Chromium, http://localhost:8096, one fresh context per page+width. Arrive, then click the first un-opened nav link in the rightmost column that has one, five times. Measured per visible .page-column-body inside the widest visible .page-columns-row: viewport x, offsetLeft inside the row, width, and the top of its first five a.page-column-item links.

columns.dx: viewport x shift of a column that was already open
columns.dleft: its layout shift inside the row
columns.dy: the largest y shift of one of its first five nav links
columns.closed: columns that were open before and are gone after

steps.skipped: no unopened nav link anywhere in the row
